Sharma et al. — Constitutional Classifiers: Defending against Universal Jailbreaks across Thousands of Hours of Red Teaming (Anthropic, 2025)

Anthropic's Safeguards Research Team guards a language model with input and output classifiers trained on synthetic data generated from a natural-language constitution of permitted and restricted content, with a streaming output classifier that can halt generation mid-response. In over 3,000 estimated hours of bug-bounty red teaming, no red teamer found a universal jailbreak extracting detail similar to an unguarded model across the target questions; an improved system blocked over 95 per cent of held-out jailbreak attempts at a 0.38-point increase in production refusals and 23.7 per cent inference overhead. The Oggy Assessment questions how far the headline outruns a bounty paid at half detail and a deployable configuration that was never human red-teamed, and what the paper implies for a real-time regulatory layer for AI.
